en: This postcard shows a colorized photograph of an urban park or garden, bordered by multi-story early-to-mid 20th-century buildings with a European architectural style. The foreground features a meticulously maintained garden with hedges, trees, and a central path, possibly with a pool or fountain. The view is taken from ground level, giving a perspective of both the greenery and the city buildings towering above.
